messages:
Kai: Morning team — quick async check-in.
What I did: rolled a KV-cache config to canary in zone-b and tuned prefix caching for embeddings flow.
Observed: p95 for small gen requests up ~20ms in canary, looks like more cache misses than expected.
Blockers: getting a noisy flood from the slo:error-rate alert — I think a metric rename in the canary is mismatching the rule.
Today: I'll triage KV eviction traces, open a hotfix PR for the alert rule, and be ready to roll back canary if needed. @Marta can you review the PR when you have a moment? @Alex if you're oncall can you look at paging thresholds?

Marta: On it. I'm in meetings until ~11:30 but will review after. Also saw deploy-bot finished a promote earlier — might be related, linking when I can.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment rc-3 finished on redwood-runtime-canary (zone-b) — 2 instances updated.

Jin: I dug into the metrics — the canary changed the metric name from `request.error.v1` -> `request_errors` so the alert filter no longer captures it. I can widen the query temporarily. Example snippet:```promql
sum(rate(request_errors[1m])) by (route) > 0.05
```We should keep the old metric name as an alias for at least a week.

Alex: Oncall here — checking alerting. If we can't patch within 15m I'll mute the noisy channel and create a ticket to update the runbook. I'll also bump debounce to 10m as a temporary measure.

Kai: Thanks. I'll open the PR in infra-alerts and add a small unit test. I'll reference the issue #3421 in the PR.

Marta: If you mute the channel, please post the reason + expected duration. Also add quick links to the dashboards in the PR description: https://dashboards.prod/redwood/slo/errors and the KV cache histogram.

Jin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-alerts/pull/567 — adds alias fallback and widens the rule. @Marta PTAL when you're free.

Alex: Muted #slo-error-rate for 35m and pinned a short note explaining why. Will unmute earlier if we confirm fix.

Kai: :thumbsup: I'll continue digging into KV traces; if I see a clear rollback signal I'll trigger it and post status here. Thanks everyone.
